answers.quick_discount: Will you give a discount if I take it today?
answers.condition: What condition is it in, any scratches or wear?
answers.defects: Does everything work, was it ever repaired?
answers.how_old: How old is it and how much was it used?
answers.original: Is it original, not a copy?
answers.documents: Do you have the receipt, the box, the documents or a warranty?
answers.details: A technical detail the listing leaves out (battery, mileage, size, material)
answers.photos: Can you send more photos or a video?
answers.delivery: Do you ship it, and who pays for the delivery?
answers.pickup: Where and when can I pick it up?
answers.try_first: Can I check or try it before paying?
answers.safe_deal: Can we use a safe deal or cash on delivery?
answers.exchange: Would you trade it for something?
answers.hold: Can you hold it for me for a few days?
answers.bulk: Do you have more of these, is there a price for several?
answers.nothing: Asks nothing: the listing answers everything, they just say they will take it
